11129.note: Forever's Combustion runs for 4 fire crits where Classic's 11129 tooltip says 3; the 3 minute cooldown is Classic's, because the Forever tooltip carries none.
11129.tooltip:
Instant
3 min cooldown
When activated, each of your Fire damage spell hits increases your critical strike chance with Fire spells by 10%.
Lasts until you have dealt 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

12043.note: registerPresenceOfMindCD is unchanged from Classic - 3 min cooldown, the next cast instant - and the Forever talent data prints the same text.

12654.note: The 8% per point and the 4 sec are Classic's, but under the Forever ruleset every other dot can crit and this one is deliberately held out, and the ticks carry SpellFlagIgnoreModifiers so the crit's multipliers are not paid twice; the id is used twice in the file, once for the applying spell and once for the tick.
12654.tooltip:
Periodic
Your critical strikes with Fire damage spells burn the target for an extra 8% of the strike's damage per talent point, 40% at 5/5, in two ticks over 4 sec.
The burn pays out exactly that share: it cannot critically strike, it does not take your damage multipliers a second time, and a fresh crit rolls the damage still owed into the new burn instead of restarting it.

assumptions: 435 to 505 base damage at level 60. The demo tooltip only showed 95 to 104, which is a rank 1, so the level 60 roll was picked to give the same damage per cast second as the level 60 Frostbolt.

240 mana at level 60; no Forever cost was published.
2.5 sec cast time; no Forever cast time was published.
30451.note: Arcane Blast is a later expansion spell, so the Classic database has no entry for 30451 at all and the site can render neither name, icon nor tooltip; the 10%, 175%, 4 stacks and 8 sec do come from the Forever talent data, the damage does not.
30451.tooltip:
240 Mana
2.5 sec cast
Blasts the target for 435 to 505 Arcane damage.
Each cast increases the damage of all your other spells by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast by 175%, stacking up to 4 times. Lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

assumptions: 115 to 133 base damage at level 60. The demo tooltip read 28 to 33, a rank 1, so this keeps Ice Lance at roughly a fifth of the level 60 Frostbolt it is cast alongside.
Spell power coefficient 0.143; no Forever scaling was published.
160 mana at level 60; no Forever cost was published.
30455.note: Ice Lance is a later expansion spell, so the Classic database has no entry for 30455 and the site renders nothing for it; the 300% frozen bonus is Forever's published number, the level 60 damage is not.
30455.tooltip:
160 Mana
Instant
Deals 115 to 133 Frost damage to an enemy target.
Deals 300% increased damage to a frozen target, which against a raid boss means one held by Fingers of Frost.

assumptions: The Missile Barrage buff lasts 15 sec. The Forever tooltip gives the proc chances and the effect but never says how long the buff sits there waiting to be spent.
44404.note: Missile Barrage is a later expansion spell, so the Classic database has no entry for 44404 and the site renders nothing; Forever's tooltip also names Frostfire Bolt, which has no Classic spell to attach to, so only Fireball and Frostbolt feed it here.
44404.tooltip:
Your Arcane Blast has a 40% chance, and your Fireball and Frostbolt a 20% chance, to grant Missile Barrage.
Your next Arcane Missiles costs no mana and fires a missile every 0.5 sec instead of every second, halving the channel. Lasts 15 sec.

44445.note: Hot Streak is a later expansion spell, so the Classic database has no entry for 44445 and the site renders nothing; the 15 sec, 25% and 3 stacks are all Forever's published numbers, and Frostfire Bolt, which the Forever tooltip also names, has no Classic spell so it cannot grant a stack here.
44445.tooltip:
Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Fire Blast and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec.
Each stack reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

assumptions: Rank 2 procs at 15%, the same as rank 1. The demo tooltip read 15% on both ranks, so a second point currently buys nothing - and the shipped talent data disagrees, printing 30% for rank 2.
A cast already in progress when the chill lands is not the 'next spell cast': it takes neither the Shatter crit nor the charge, and the cast after it takes both.
44543.note: Fingers of Frost is a later expansion spell, so the Classic database has no entry for 44543 and the site renders nothing; Shatter's crit bonus is folded into this aura because a raid boss can never be chilled or frozen by anything else, and the talent's rank 2 id 44544 is never used.
44543.tooltip:
Your Chill effects have a 15% chance to grant Fingers of Frost, which treats your next spell cast as though the target were frozen. Lasts 15 sec.
While it is up your spells gain Shatter's critical strike chance, 10% per point of Shatter, and Ice Lance deals its frozen damage.
